turns.text: Now I've heard there was a secret chord
turns.zh: 我听说有一个秘密和弦

turns.text: That David played, and it pleased the Lord
turns.zh: 大卫弹奏它，取悦了主

turns.text: But you don't really care for music, do you?
turns.zh: 可你其实并不怎么喜欢音乐，对吧？

turns.text: It goes like this, the fourth, the fifth
turns.zh: 它是这样的，第四，第五

turns.text: The minor falls, the major lifts
turns.zh: 小调落下，大调升起

turns.text: The baffled king composing Hallelujah
turns.zh: 困惑的国王谱写着哈利路亚

turns.text: Hallelujah, Hallelujah
turns.zh: 哈利路亚，哈利路亚

turns.text: Hallelujah, Hallelujah
turns.zh: 哈利路亚，哈利路亚

turns.text: Your faith was strong but you needed proof
turns.zh: 你的信仰很坚定，但你需要证明

turns.text: You saw her bathing on the roof
turns.zh: 你看见她在屋顶上沐浴

turns.text: Her beauty and the moonlight overthrew you
turns.zh: 她的美貌和月光将你击倒

turns.text: She tied you to a kitchen chair
turns.zh: 她把你绑在厨房的椅子上

turns.text: She broke your throne, and she cut your hair
turns.zh: 她打碎了你的王座，剪掉了你的头发

turns.text: And from your lips she drew the Hallelujah
turns.zh: 从你唇间她引出了那声哈利路亚

turns.text: Hallelujah, Hallelujah
turns.zh: 哈利路亚，哈利路亚

turns.text: Hallelujah, Hallelujah
turns.zh: 哈利路亚，哈利路亚

turns.text: You say I took the name in vain
turns.zh: 你说我妄称了主的名

turns.text: I don't even know the name
turns.zh: 我连那个名字都不知道

turns.text: But if I did, well, really, what's it to you?
turns.zh: 但就算我知道，那又跟你有什么关系？

turns.text: There's a blaze of light in every word
turns.zh: 每个字里都有一道火焰般的光

turns.text: It doesn't matter which you heard
turns.zh: 你听到的是哪个并不重要

turns.text: The holy or the broken Hallelujah
turns.zh: 是神圣的还是破碎的哈利路亚

turns.text: Hallelujah, Hallelujah
turns.zh: 哈利路亚，哈利路亚

turns.text: Hallelujah, Hallelujah
turns.zh: 哈利路亚，哈利路亚

turns.text: I did my best, it wasn't much
turns.zh: 我尽了力，虽然微不足道

turns.text: I couldn't feel, so I tried to touch
turns.zh: 我感受不到，所以我试着去触摸

turns.text: I've told the truth, I didn't come to fool you
turns.zh: 我说了实话，我不是来骗你的

turns.text: And even though it all went wrong
turns.zh: 即使一切都出了错

turns.text: I'll stand before the Lord of Song
turns.zh: 我也会站在歌之主面前

turns.text: With nothing on my tongue but Hallelujah
turns.zh: 舌上除了哈利路亚别无他物
